judge.rationale: The core validation and schema compilation logic in `ToolRegistry` works and uses `ajv` with a `WeakMap` cache for dynamic schemas as requested. However, the candidate stopped halfway through its own Definition of Done and missed numerous explicit acceptance criteria. Specifically, `src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts` only contains a single test (putting 4 other tests into an unrequested `registry.acceptance.test.ts` file and omitting tests for extra properties passthrough, dynamic schema switching, static compilation reuse, and unknown tool throws), and `chatOrchestrator.test.ts` was not updated at all. Additionally, the required one-line doc comment on `execute`, the updates to `README.md`, `docs/adding-a-tool.md`, `.specify/spec.md`, `example/weather-tool.ts`, and the full `CHANGELOG.md` entry were all omitted, while a temporary `.lore/dod.md` file was left tracked in the repo.
